top_choice_rationale: DMFT's foundational dynamical mapping and limiting construction give the Georges-Vollhardt-Kotliar proposal a coherent theoretical scope and a lasting explanation of correlated spectra beyond static band descriptions. Its mature physical content, not code popularity or universal material exactness, keeps it first. QSH is the strongest new-phase rival and clocks a sharply testable invention; the exact-relations proposal remains less secure in its boundary around Seifert. All require original-credit scrutiny, but those unresolved dossiers do not erase the mature achievements or make no award preferable.
